description: Create an email template. subject, html and text may use {{key}} variables; fallbacks gives a default per key, and a key without one must be passed on every send. Values are inserted as text, never as HTML. The template is a draft until published: set publish to true, or publish it later, before sending it.

fallbacks.description: Default value per variable key. A {{key}} without a fallback is required at send time. Every key must be used by the subject, html or text.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key. If omitted, the MCP server generates one for POST tools.

publish.description: Also publish the draft as version 1, so sends can use it at once.

name: shipmail_create_template

has_unpublished_changes.description: True when the draft differs from the published version, or nothing is published.

published_version.description: The version a send uses. Null until the first publish.

title: Create Template
